limits: All eight contact sheets and their complete source forms were inspected after correcting field-of-view framing.
Native parts remain at original source coordinates and elevation; no model deformation or terrain changes were made.
One normal context remains substantially obscured (Pedder); all isolated views are inspectable.
Isolated views hide unrelated buildings but retain terrain and other context such as roads/bridges.
Existing procedural window spacing is illustrative and can misrepresent storey counts.
Proposed landmark identities are retained as proposals; exact source UID/model CSUID matching is separate.
A final installed representative check is required after concurrent road changes.
